svg.text: 6 auth paths · JWT (HS256) · Refresh token rotation · API keys · RBAC
sign access JWT · gen 32-byte refresh token
C. TOKEN REFRESH (family rotation + reuse detection)
mark old used_at · insert new (same family_id)
on reuse: UPDATE family SET revoked_at
request: always 202 · if user found: INSERT
confirm: hash lookup · bcrypt new pw
E. INVITATION FLOW (admin creates · anyone accepts)
accept: validate expiry · INSERT users · consumed_at
F. API KEY AUTHENTICATION (stateless-ish · ownerPool lookup)
TTL: max 900s (15 min) — short enough, no revocation list needed
Never stored server-side · stateless verification in makeAuthenticate()
owner (3) → all ops incl. org cancel, role changes
admin (2) → billing, invitations, API keys, export
member (1) → project CRUD (also: all API key requests)
last-owner guard: cannot demote sole remaining owner
Fires after authentication, before any handler
